name: Rolling Burrito
about: A Mexican food truck on Lee Highway in Falls Church. Customers call out the birria tacos, flavorful burritos, and fast, friendly service.
address: 7399 Lee Hwy Service Rd, Falls Church, VA 22042

reviews.author: Connor B.
reviews.text: The Birria tacos were perfect. I also had a chorizo taco which was delicious. My wife loved the steak quesadilla.

reviews.author: Shashank R.
reviews.text: The service was very fast and the lady was very helpful. The chicken and the chorizo were really really flavorful.

reviews.author: Christina S.
reviews.text: Pumping gas and looked behind me and delighted to see a burrito truck. Solid.
